warmup.description: Prepare the whole body with dynamic mobility and light activation across major movement patterns.

main_exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
main_exercises.load_guidance: Choose a moderate weight you could perform 12 reps with, stopping at 8-10
main_exercises.form_cue: Drive through legs and transition smoothly into the overhead press

main_exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load at 7/10 effort focusing on hamstring stretch
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep back flat and hinge from hips, not lower back

main_exercises.name: Push-Up (floor or elevated)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Choose a variation that leaves 2-3 reps in reserve
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep body in a straight line and lower with control

main_exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use a weight that challenges the last reps without twisting your torso
main_exercises.form_cue: Pull elbow toward your hip and keep shoulders square

main_exercises.name: Reverse Lunges (Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load allowing balance and control throughout
main_exercises.form_cue: Step back softly and keep front knee stable

cooldown.description: Bring the body down gradually and release tension from major muscle groups.

phase_notes.menstrual: This balanced session can feel manageable—reduce load or reps if needed and move at a steady pace. Focus on maintaining energy rather than pushing intensity.
phase_notes.follicular: Great phase to build momentum—slightly increase load or reps and focus on smooth transitions in compound movements like thrusters.
phase_notes.ovulatory: You can perform these movements with strong coordination and power—push toward the higher end of rep ranges while maintaining good form.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Keep effort consistent and avoid rushing through exercises—this is a good session to reinforce solid movement patterns across the whole body.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Focus on controlled tempo and reduce intensity if needed—this session works well as a steady, lower-pressure full-body workout.
